turns.question: Which day of the week had the highest average daily ad spend across all campaigns in September 2026, and what was that average in EUR?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for average daily ad spend by weekday, so I cannot name the day or its average; the closest is Ad spend (EUR), which is summed per day across campaigns for September 2026 (1-30 September) and not averaged by weekday. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
